calculation.expression: -(close_t/close_{t-3}-1) * log(1 + volume_t / rolling_median(volume,20)_t), then cross-sectional median de-mean
calculation.description: Ranks recent three-day losers more strongly when current volume is elevated relative to the trailing 20-day median. Signal is computed using data through the decision date and predicts next-day returns.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC across 2020-2027 cutoff and positive regime means; daily ICIR clears benchmark gates. Five-day ICIR is below the gate, so use as a short-horizon component and monitor drift conservatively.
